- {{inputs.initial_deposit}}: Opening deposit in USD (example for this run: «inputs.initial_deposit»)

Outputs to extract:
- account_type (string): Account type as shown on the review screen
- initial_deposit (money): Initial deposit as shown on the review screen

outcomes.description: Search ran but no member exists with the given member number.
The member number failed app-side validation (e.g. not 5 digits).
Teller lacks permission to view/act on this member (restricted account).
The sub-account form rejected the account type / initial deposit values (e.g. deposit below product minimum).

input.notes: Flow: Member Inquiry search by member number -> member detail -> "Open Sub-Account" link (URL carries m=<member_id>, but the flow follows the link from the detail screen so no URL editing is needed) -> select Account Type, leave Nickname blank (optional), fill Initial Deposit -> Continue -> subacct_review. Outputs read from the review table: Account Type cell ("Holiday Club") and Initial Deposit cell ("«initial_deposit»", displayed with currency formatting). The irreversible "Confirm" button on the review screen is deliberately NOT clicked; a Cancel link back to the form is also present. All app UI lives in nested iframes (nav frame + content frame). If a member_alert interstitial appears after search, a human must read and act on it (use request_help); other interstitials (system_notice, service_unavailable, session_expired, signed_out) are handled by the app's state library.
